question: The World Chess Champion Vishwanathan Anand belongs to which Country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishwanathan Anand** is a world-renowned chess player who has won numerous titles and championships.
 
• He hails from** India **and is considered a national treasure in the country.
 
• Anand's mastery of the game has earned him worldwide recognition and acclaim, and he continues to be a dominant force in the world of chess.
 
• Vishwanath Anand__ is the first Indian chess grandmaster.
 
 
• Vishwanathan Anand has been awarded the 6th Hridaynath Mangeshkar Award in 2016.
 
• Vishwanath Anand is the first sportsperson to be awarded the Hridaynath Mangeshkar Award.
 
• He is also a former world chess champion.
 
• He has won the world chess championship five times.
 
• An autobiography - 'Mind Master' was launched in December 2020. 
 
• He was the first recipient of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 1991–92.
 
• He is the first sportsperson to receive the Padma Vibhushan award.
